summary.en: Explore, tune and export interactive UI motion.
summary.zh: 体验、调节并导出 UI 动效。

en: TuneShape is an interactive UI motion playground. Browse effects, compare before and after, adjust the parameters and try the interaction directly.

The preview, explanations, Motion parameters and exportable JSON come from the same configuration. Import an exported JSON file to restore the effect; observation speed stays separate from the saved configuration.
Try the live demo to explore the playground. You can also discover the other projects on GitHub, read their READMEs and give a project a Star if it helps you.
zh: TuneShape 是一个可交互的 UI 动效实验台。按用途浏览动效，对比调整前后，修改参数后直接体验交互。
预览、文字说明、Motion 参数与可导出的 JSON 来自同一份配置；重新导入 JSON 可以还原动效，观察倍速不会写入保存的配置。
可以打开在线演示体验，也欢迎到 GitHub 查看其他项目，从 README 开始；如果对你有帮助，欢迎给项目一个 Star。
